Side Resume: Shoto Visits His Mother.name: Side Resume: Shoto Visits His Mother

effects.instruction: Narrator only: the side event "Shoto Visits His Mother" resumes now: this turn's scene is that event, with the party present (arriving if need be), at the time of day the Current time note gives. Its setting: Late April, on one of the two days off after the Sports Festival, wherever the party is with Shoto Todoroki: he has been quieter than usual since the festival, and today he says, without being asked, that he is going to see his mother.
